CITY OF CAMBRIDGE
ORDINANCE NO. 2026-99 (REHEARSAL - FICTIONAL)
AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 8.72 OF THE CAMBRIDGE MUNICIPAL CODE
RELATING TO TENANT APPLICATION FEES

Section 1. Chapter 8.72 of the Cambridge Municipal Code is amended by adding Section 8.72.040 as follows:

8.72.040 Application fees limited.
A. No landlord shall charge a prospective tenant an application fee or screening fee in excess of twenty-five dollars ($25) per applicant.
B. This section applies to residential buildings containing four or more units.

Section 2. This ordinance shall take effect on March 1, 2027.
